svg.title: Local controlled replay: lineage preserved versus omitted
svg.desc: A saved normalized USGS sample is replayed locally with a new receipt time. The same alias bytes are processed with lineage retained or omitted. Forged-parent and hash-mismatch receipts are rejected. No original USGS response or historic receipt is claimed.
svg.text: 本地受控回放：保留谱系与丢失谱系对照
Saved normalized USGS sample · no new collection · no NWS access · no notification
